200.description: NDJSON: one StatsExportTicketLine per ticket (`type: "ticket"`), then one StatsExportRunLine per run (`type: "run"`); the schema is that of one line. Run lines carry `tokens` and its categories (`tokensInput`, `tokensOutput`, `tokensCacheRead`, `tokensCacheWrite`, null when usage is unknown). Every line carries factoryId and definitions, so another factory's export can be compared row by row.

default.description: A problem: the request was refused or failed.

202.description: The delivery was checked and handled.

default.description: A problem: the request was refused or failed.

ref.description: A GitHub issue URL, owner/repo#n, #n, KEY-123, or a local file.

id.description: An id for a ticket given as text.

TicketKey.description: A ticket key: the name of its factory directory, `<slug>-<hash8>`.

answer.description: The answer for the waiting agent.

instanceId.description: The server instance holding the lease. It changes on every start.

type.description: A stable code clients can switch on.

path.description: Where the problem is, such as `body.ref` or `query.stage`.

name.description: The API client the token belongs to.

onBehalfOf.description: The X-Factory-On-Behalf-Of header, as sent. Never verified.

scope.description: What the token may do: `read`, or `act`, which includes read. Routes still check it.

enabled.description: Whether new tickets run this stage: always for a required stage.

name.description: The stage. The stages array gives the order.

optional.description: An optional stage runs only when FACTORY.json turns it on.

perTask.description: Whether the stage runs once per task.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last.

execution.description: The generation; it grows with reruns.

needsUser.description: Waiting for a reply, paused, failed, or ready for handoff.

pullRequest.description: The ticket's pull request, once wrap-up or sync has found it.

startedBy.description: The API client that started the ticket.

trackerWarnings.description: Tracker updates that failed. The ticket went on regardless.

current.description: The task in work or review, such as `03/06 Overview page`.

next.description: The Pi command a person runs next.

onBehalfOf.description: As the client sent it. Unverified.

message.description: What the controller did, for people.

revision.description: The events.revision that recorded the command. The event stream passes it.

execution.description: The generation; it grows with reruns.

needsUser.description: Waiting for a reply, paused, failed, or ready for handoff.

pullRequest.description: The ticket's pull request, once wrap-up or sync has found it.

startedBy.description: The API client that started the ticket.

trackerWarnings.description: Tracker updates that failed. The ticket went on regardless.

source.description: The issue or brief this execution started from, as fetched then. Null for an execution recorded before the factory kept it.

author.description: The tracker login of whoever opened the issue; null for a written brief.

body.description: The issue description or the brief, as markdown.

fetchedAt.description: When the factory read the source.

summaries.description: The latest result of each stage, such as the review round.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last.

activity.description: The agent's latest assistant message in this run, from its session file.

outcome.description: What the run led to, as the status cards say it. Display text: map on outcomeKind.

outcomeKind.description: What the run led to, as a stable key.

sessionFile.description: The Pi session file of the run's session. Open it with `pi --session`.

fetchedAt.description: When the tracker was last asked.

author.description: The tracker login of whoever opened it.

body.description: Its description, as markdown the tracker holds.

displayRef.description: The ref to start it with, such as owner/repo#42.

umbrella.description: It has sub-issues, so it cannot be started.

changesRequested.description: Rounds whose commit drew a review asking for changes.

commented.description: Rounds whose commit only drew comments with a body.

distribution.description: Tickets with a merged or abandoned pull request, by their number of rounds.

mergeRate.description: Merged over merged, abandoned, and cancelled. Open and unknown are left out.

neededAPerson.description: Tickets with at least one human intervention.

returnsToWork.description: By the stage that sent the task back.

setup.description: The model setup: model and thinking level.

tokensCacheRead.description: Cached input read, in tokens; null when usage is unknown.

tokensCacheWrite.description: Input written to the cache, in tokens; null when usage is unknown.

tokensInput.description: Input tokens, excluding cached input; null when usage is unknown.

tokensOutput.description: Output tokens; null when usage is unknown.

configuration.description: The model setup of every stage, `stage=setup …`.

tokensCacheRead.description: Cached input read, in tokens; null when usage is unknown.

tokensCacheWrite.description: Input written to the cache, in tokens; null when usage is unknown.

tokensInput.description: Input tokens, excluding cached input; null when usage is unknown.

tokensCacheRead.description: Cached input read, in tokens; null when usage is unknown.

tokensCacheWrite.description: Input written to the cache, in tokens; null when usage is unknown.

tokensInput.description: Input tokens, excluding cached input; null when usage is unknown.

tokensOutput.description: Output tokens; null when usage is unknown.

configuration.description: The run's ticket configuration, as on its ticket line.

passed.description: Whether validation accepted the run's output; null when not validated.

returnedFrom.description: For a return to work, the stage that sent the task back.

setup.description: The model setup: model and thinking level.

tokensCacheRead.description: Cached input read, in tokens; null when usage is unknown.

tokensCacheWrite.description: Input written to the cache, in tokens; null when usage is unknown.

tokensInput.description: Input tokens, excluding cached input; null when usage is unknown.

tokensOutput.description: Output tokens; null when usage is unknown.

ticket.description: The ticket the delivery updated, or null when it was ignored.

actor.description: The API client behind a command; null for everything else.

card.description: For `card` events, the status card the controller posted.

ticket.description: The ticket key, when the event has one.

EventPayload.description: The data of a /v1/events event. The SSE `id` is the revision and `event` is the kind, such as `start`, `reply`, `runtime_terminal`, `validation_finished`, or `card`.

bearer.description: An API client token from `factory token create <name> --scope read|act`. Routes list the scope they need; `act` includes `read`.
